Best food in Hanoi
Nov 2023 • Friends
At the end of a tour of Vietnam from south to north. I wanted something other than the beautiful Vietnamese food that we had been eating. I was told how extraordinary this place was in Hanoi. I was not disappointed, we started with a few tapas dishes and then had the Spanish Seafood Paella, finishing off with the cheesecake. 

The authenticity of the food is amazing,
I am aware they source a lot of their product from Spain, so it’s no wonder it’s authentic. Has the opportunity of meeting Mr Tam and Miss Thuy. What beautiful people. Please support this restaurant, I am not easy to please, but I thought it transported me back to Spain or South America.

One of the best Spanish restaurant
Sep 2023 • Friends
One of the best Spanish restaurant I’ve ever been. Having a short trip with my besties and we found this new restaurant online.
The atmosphere of the restaurant is very cozy and chill. The vibes is just so relaxing and amazing.
 The staff are very helpful and they explain the dishes in detail. 

They have not just Spanish food, but fusion food.
The dishes’ portion is big enough for us. I personally love the oyster so much. They are reasonable prices and so fresh. 
Recommend to travellers!

Amazing Spanish restaurant with best interior design
Sep 2023 • Friends
I have literally found my new favourite place to eat and drink on Hanoi ! If I could give 10 stars I would!Vamos staff were friendly and had a great attitude. The food came out quickly and was incredible..packed with authentic Spanish flavours and aroma ! You won’t be disappointed! We also ordered the ceviche and I’m definitely not a fish person, but damn!! They were super tasty!
Chef was very passionate about Spanish foods and we went above and beyond our expectations. 
Restaurant interior and design takes me to Spain like a Time Machine. Well done guys we will come back again for more.
Couldn’t have had a better experience!

Fusion Tapas Kitchen Bar in Hanoi
Jul 2023 • Friends
The restaurant's space is extremely cozy, friendly with a bit of Spanish, Latin, and Mediterranean style, looks very pleasant, I haven’t found any tapas restaurant similar with this style in Hanoi. If I had to choose, I would choose to sit outside near the open kitchen bar.

Foods is Spanish Fusion, I ordered some dishes, all is truly impressive, excepted sweet potation chips, it is a bit hard, pale and oily

About drink, you guys if come here must try cocktail named Frambuesa, it has light pink color, so good and looks beautiful too.
